lines.hanzi: 学一门外语很有用，也很有趣。
lines.pinyin: Xué yī mén wàiyǔ hěn yǒuyòng, yě hěn yǒuqù.
lines.english: Learning a foreign language is very useful, and also very interesting.

lines.pinyin: Wǒ xué Zhōngwén xué le hěn duō nián.
lines.english: I've studied Chinese for many years.

lines.hanzi: 开始很难，单词记不住，语法不懂。
lines.pinyin: Kāishǐ hěn nán, dāncí jì bu zhù, yǔfǎ bu dǒng.
lines.english: At first it was very hard: I couldn't remember words, didn't understand grammar.

lines.hanzi: 后来我每天努力听、说、读、写。
lines.pinyin: Hòulái wǒ měitiān nǔlì tīng, shuō, dú, xiě.
lines.english: Later I worked hard every day at listening, speaking, reading and writing.

lines.hanzi: 看中文电影，听中文歌，和外国朋友说话。
lines.pinyin: Kàn Zhōngwén diànyǐng, tīng Zhōngwén gē, hé wàiguó péngyou shuōhuà.
lines.english: Watch Chinese movies, listen to Chinese songs, talk with foreign friends.

lines.hanzi: 现在我能和外国人用中文说话了。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ néng hé wàiguórén yòng Zhōngwén shuōhuà le.
lines.english: Now I can speak Chinese with foreigners.

lines.hanzi: 学外语不但能找好工作，还能了解世界。
lines.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ búdàn néng zhǎo hǎo gōngzuò, hái néng liǎojiě shìjiè.
lines.english: Learning a foreign language not only helps you find good work, but also understand the world.

lines.hanzi: 我想再学一门外语，比如日语。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài xué yī mén wàiyǔ, bǐrú Rìyǔ.
lines.english: I want to learn another foreign language, for example Japanese.

lines.hanzi: 学哪门外语，努力都很重要。
lines.pinyin: Xué nǎ mén wàiyǔ, nǔlì dōu hěn zhòngyào.
lines.english: Whichever foreign language you learn, hard work is always important.
